Ship runs aground in Strait of Hormuz amid regional tensions

A container ship ran aground in the Strait of Hormuz, a vital energy transit point. Iran stated it was a foreign container ship and asserted control over shipping lanes. The strait had previously been designated a war-like operations area following attacks on vessels.
